textPipeline.vectorization: Unicode code points (JS Array.from), unigrams then adjacent bigrams; unknown grams ignored; zero norm stays zero
textPipeline.output: OperationsMath.mlp outputs3logits; argmax maps to classes; scores are not calibrated compliance probability

extractor.normalization: NFKC,lowercase; keep whitespace for field patterns

negationScope.rule: retain negation cues only in a clause containing sulfur/硫; keep evidence separate from classifier logits

extractor.boundary: Demo audit limits are classroom assumptions, not legal product specifications. Unspecified % basis is unresolved, not automatically wt%.

optimization.objective: lexicographic maximize covered risk, then minimize sum minutes*reviewer.costPerMinute
constraints: each task assigned at most once
optimization.unassigned: allowed and visibly retained; never claim all tasks reviewed
optimization.independentReference: Python exhaustive enumeration over(-1,0,1,2)^taskCount; -1 means unassigned

validation.split: template-family groups train5×3×16=240; validate1×3×16=48; heldout2×3×16=96; no row-random split
validation.metric: assertion accuracy on unseen wording families
validation.boundary: Synthetic wording and cases; status label is textual assertion, not numeric quality truth. Numeric contradictions intentionally remain review tasks.
